_: Does the floor number actually move the camera? Recorded eye heights for the same building at different floors, from the two cold passes, with the formula the app documents: eye = (floor - 1) * ASSUMED_FLOOR_HEIGHT_M + EYE_ABOVE_FLOOR_M, clamped to the real roof.
